codec/README.md: table row and WOG golden wording now say hsmm/v3; notes v2 supportWeight and v3 imputedTerms and no-migration; restates the already-ruled portability split (byte-exact re-encode of one artifact; no bit-identity across Native libm reruns).

docs/adr/0001 paragraph on the HSMM object: tag hsmm/v3; cost object now lists required supportWeight and imputedTerms with the no-invent reason. Encoding-order and contextual-decode bullets unchanged.

No source/schema bump. No commit. Chief: review and I will mote done after ack.
